abstentions_logged: QB abstention per team-game and cutoff, MISSED cutoffs, BLOCKED games, in phase2a_ledger/game_status.jsonl

automation.mechanism: manual workflow_dispatch only (no cron, no scheduler or production change): generate -> freeze -> push the ledger append; grade -> report
automation.note: an operator who wants automatic runs must add a schedule trigger deliberately; this phase adds none
procedure: Actions -> NFL V2 Phase2A forward shadow -> Run workflow, mode=forecast, on branch codex/nfl-outcome-engine-v2, inside the T24 window (kickoff-48h to kickoff-24h) and again inside the T90 window (kickoff-3h to kickoff-90min)

comparators.identical_players: comparisons use identical player-games only; populations are never combined
comparators.recorded_with_each_forecast: a separate comparator ledger row, created before the cutoff, holds: the frozen competent-human projection (nfl_v2_competent_human_baseline.receipt, formula unchanged), a simple baseline (prior-3-game mean of the stat), and the V1 central projection when the V1 pick log published one before the cutoff (V1 is read-only, projected_median only; V1 unavailable is recorded, never imputed). The V2 forecast object is built without access to any comparator or to any V1 field.

critical_order: 3 prove no outcome can be read, cutoff enforcement and immutability by tests
5 only then generate real forecasts (separate commit)

cutoffs.definition: kickoff_utc = games schedule gameday + gametime interpreted as America/New_York, converted to UTC (Phase1M definition)
cutoffs.independence: T24 and T90 are separate forecasts with separate ids. T90 may use newer inputs; both are preserved so the value of later information can be measured.
cutoffs.late_generation: refused; recorded as a MISSED event
cutoffs.rule: A forecast may be generated only inside its window: window_opens <= generated_at < cutoff <= kickoff. Before the window opens the game is NOT_YET_DUE (nothing is written). After the cutoff the game is MISSED_T24_CUTOFF / MISSED_T90_CUTOFF (logged once, never created, never backfilled). The CLI has no clock override; generated_at is the system clock at write time and the guard is re-evaluated immediately before every append. Every input retrieval must also finish before the cutoff.

eligibility_rule.availability: availability_state is the target-week roster status as published at retrieval time. availability_confidence MEDIUM only when the target-week roster row exists with status ACT; LOW otherwise. Injury designations are NOT an input (no timestamp-safe source): every forecast carries INJURY_DESIGNATIONS_NOT_AN_INPUT and ROSTER_STATUS_ONLY_AVAILABILITY. Availability uncertainty is the model's responsibility and is never censored.
eligibility_rule.data_completeness: history game counts, share-history length, roster-row publication and input digests are recorded per forecast
eligibility_rule.history_gate: a game is BLOCKED_HISTORY_INCOMPLETE (no forecast) unless team stats exist for each team's most recent scheduled game before the target week; BLOCKED_ROSTER_NOT_PUBLISHED when a team has fewer than 40 target-week roster rows
eligibility_rule.no_fringe_padding: players below the frozen meaningful-participant thresholds get no forecast; no zero-expectation players are added
eligibility_rule.receiving: player on the target-week roster with an active status (frozen Phase1D active_status), position RB/FB/HB/WR/TE, and in the frozen Phase1D fixed meaningful population for rec_yds: prior-3-game average targets for the current team >= 3.0 with >= 2 prior games
eligibility_rule.role_confidence: HIGH: >= 4 prior team games in the last 8 and prior-3 average >= 2x the threshold and last-3 share range <= 0.08 (targets) / 0.15 (carries); MEDIUM: >= 3 prior team games and average >= threshold; LOW otherwise
eligibility_rule.rushing: same roster rule, position RB/FB/HB only (QB rushing needs QB state and is abstained), and prior-3-game average carries for the current team >= 5.0 with >= 2 prior games

freeze.improvements: any future research improvement gets a new version and is never applied to existing forecasts
freeze.lock: phase2a_engine_lock.json records the sha256 of every engine file and every frozen upstream artifact; tests fail if any differs; no engine change during the evaluation window

grading.actuals: official nflverse weekly stats of the player in that game; a player with no stat row is graded as 0 (raw ledger)
grading.no_tuning: no threshold, formula or population is tuned on forward results
grading.provenance: the grader verifies the hash chain, generated_at < cutoff_time <= kickoff_time for every graded forecast and records the first git commit time of each ledger line; a forecast whose proof fails is excluded and listed
grading.raw_vs_clean: RAW keeps every row. CLEAN excludes only rows listed in the censor registry (phase2a_censors.json) as CENSORED_IN_GAME: a documented in-game injury, ejection or abnormal exit that truncated normal playing time. Poor performances, ordinary benchings and pre-game absences are never censored.
grading.when: a game is graded only after the schedule marks it final AND official stats rows exist for both teams

rules: existing lines are never modified or deleted (CI and tests compare to the base commit prefix)
forecast_id is deterministic: a duplicate is skipped, never overwritten
a code or config change creates a NEW engine_version and a new ledger family; old forecasts are never rewritten
immutability.storage: append-only JSONL ledgers under phase2a_ledger/, one JSON object per line with seq, prev_line_sha256, record_sha256, line_sha256 (hash chain)

allowed: pinned 2023-2025 nflverse weekly stats and rosters (digest-verified)
2026 weekly stats, rosters and play-by-play as published before the cutoff (digest recorded at retrieval; stats and rosters archived content-addressed)
schedule rows restricted to game_id, season, game_type, week, gameday, gametime, away_team, home_team
forbidden: any target-game result, score, stat, snap, participation or postgame starter state
sportsbook lines, odds, spreads, totals, moneylines
injury designations, depth charts, snaps, routes (not accepted inputs)
target-week stat rows: if any stat row exists for a target game the forecast is refused (OUTCOME_DATA_PRESENT)
inputs.history_rule: all history is filtered to (season, week) strictly earlier than the target week before any index is built

by: stable vs uncertain role (role_confidence HIGH vs MEDIUM/LOW)
metrics.paired: for each player and head with both a T24 and a T90 forecast: T24 absolute error, T90 absolute error, delta; aggregate T90 improved / worsened / unchanged
metrics.passing_note: only if the QB gate passes; none expected until a provider is accepted
metrics.population_rule: every comparison uses identical player-games; no unfair pooling

preregistration: Committed BEFORE the engine lock, before any forward forecast exists and before any forward outcome exists. Research / shadow only: NO production promotion, no sportsbook input, no Monte Carlo, no model fitting, no thresholds tuned on forward results.
promotion: NONE in this phase. Production promotion requires a future explicit certification protocol; V1 production is untouched.
purpose: Accumulate clean forward evidence for the surviving V2 central-projection chain. Every forecast is generated before its cutoff, frozen in an append-only hash-chained ledger, and later graded against official results.

qb_gate.provider_status: NO_AUTHORIZED_PROVIDER; nothing connects to a vendor
qb_gate.rule: Only CERTIFIED (a visible, as-of-certified Phase1M-schema record at the cutoff) may produce an official V2 QB central projection. With no accepted source the state is BLOCKED and every team-game logs ABSTAIN_QB_STATE_UNCERTIFIED; the abstentions are counted. No QB projection is ever generated from an uncertified starter assumption, and no fallback is used.

scope_rule: Only games whose kickoff is at or after evaluation_start_utc and that have not started when first seen are in scope. The week number is never assumed: games come from schedule timestamps.

surviving_components.chain: final_receiving_yards = Phase1B team targets x Phase1D target share x Phase1F yards per target; final_receptions = the frozen rec head (same structure with catch rate); final_rushing_yards = Phase1B team carries x Phase1D carry share x Phase1F yards per carry. Engine code reuses nfl_v2_phase1e_integrated.receipt unchanged.
surviving_components.monte_carlo: NOT INCLUDED; the central projection is evaluated first
surviving_components.player_carry_share: frozen Phase1D carry-share allocator (outcomes.rush_yds selected_config); Phase1O and Phase1Q replacements rejected
surviving_components.player_target_share: frozen Phase1D target-share allocator (outcomes.rec_yds / rec selected_config in phase1d_role_allocation_snapshot.json); Phase1O and Phase1Q replacements rejected
surviving_components.qb_efficiency: frozen incumbent only where QB opportunity is legitimately available (never, until the QB gate passes)
surviving_components.qb_opportunity: BLOCKED_STARTER_STATE_DATA: no official V2 QB forecast without a CERTIFIED QB state; abstain otherwise
surviving_components.receiving_diagnostics: Phase1G decomposition (catch rate, completed air per catch, YAC per catch; selected_config in phase1g_receiving_mechanics_snapshot.json) is attached to receipts for DIAGNOSTIC use only and never changes a final projection
surviving_components.receiving_efficiency: frozen Phase1F/Phase1B incumbent yards-per-target and catch-rate (outcomes.rec_yds / rec selected_efficiency_config); no Phase1H/I replacement
surviving_components.rushing_efficiency: frozen Phase1B/Phase1F incumbent yards-per-carry (outcomes.rush_yds selected_efficiency_config); Phase1K replacement rejected
surviving_components.team_opportunity: frozen Phase1B team-volume formula (outcomes.<head>.selected_opportunity_config in phase1b_opportunity_snapshot.json); Phase1N replacement rejected
